tooling: REST API + SDK exist (https://www.transfernow.net/en/discover/transfernow-api-sdk) — multipart, notifications, but behind a paid/14-day-trial plan.
chaining: 5 GB x unlimited free 7-day transfers. Not storage: the free row literally says 'No storage'.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 5 GB free. Retention: 7 days free (365 paid). request-rate: not published. The '5 TB per file' figure belongs to the paid API tier, not to free.
reliability_note: Clean, honest pricing page — the free tier is a transfer service only. No free path to durability.
